subject: history_social
passage: In the dry zone of northern and eastern Sri Lanka, most of the year's rain falls within a few months, and the land can be parched for the rest of the year. More than two thousand years ago, communities there began building tanks, large reservoirs enclosed by earthen banks, to catch and hold rainwater. Channels then carried water from the tanks to rice fields. These tanks most likely allowed farmers to ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: move their rice fields to the wetter parts of the island.
choices.B: stop depending on rain as a source of water for their crops.
choices.C: grow rice only during the months of heaviest rain.
choices.D: water their crops even during months with little rain.

explanation.why: Rain falls in only a few months, but the tanks stored that rain and channels carried it to the fields. Stored water could therefore reach the crops during the dry part of the year.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The text says nothing about moving fields elsewhere on the island.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This goes too far: the tanks were filled by rainwater, so farmers still depended on rain.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This reverses the purpose of the tanks; storing water frees farmers from the rainy months alone.
explanation.D: Correct. Water stored during the rainy months could be sent to fields when little rain was falling.
